actors.name: Robert Downey Jr.
actors.description: Sarcastic humorous deliveries while remaining completely stonefaced, distinctive drawling voice. Frequently plays egotistical but likable scoundrels and intelligent but eccentric characters. Famous for Iron Man and Sherlock Holmes roles.

actors.name: Chris Hemsworth
actors.description: Deep resonant voice and muscular physique. Best known for playing Thor in the MCU.

actors.name: Scarlett Johansson
actors.description: Often plays characters who look and act older than their age. Full lips and green eyes. Seductive husky voice. Contralto singing voice. Mole on her right cheek

actors.name: Chris Pratt
actors.description: Affable, gregarious if somewhat goofy persona. Says dude a lot, has a tall stature.

actors.name: Hugh Jackman
actors.description: Ruggedly handsome features, renown for his persuasive american accent, muscular physique, deep resonant voice
